The core issue arises from a mismatch between TypeScript target version and language feature usage. BigInt literals, introduced in ES2020, are incompatible with ES2017. The root cause lies in `apps/web`'s tsconfig.json targeting ES2017 while importing modules using BigInt. The solution involves raising only the web app’s target to ES2020, aligning with Node 20+ runtime support. This preserves semantic integrity without altering broader workspace configurations. Stale incremental caches further complicate resolution, necessitating their removal to ensure clean recompilation. The dual nature of this problem—syntax incompatibility and caching artifacts—requires both configuration adjustment and artifact cleanup for full resolution.
